highlights: Agents do many browser actions in one step, so browser tasks finish sooner and use fewer tokens, and Cloudflare checks pass in the built-in browser.
Right-click an agent message and select Mark unread to come back to it later.
Hide the Local server when you have another server; its agents, chats and files stay on your computer.
Choose the sound that plays when a task finishes, in Settings › Notifications.
Each provider CLI now uses about half the disk space, and OpenBot uses the CLI you installed when it is as new as its own copy.
